name: foundry
description: Idea to merge: guided framing, ADRs, precise issues, value-first roadmap, and a gated delivery loop over pluggable tracker and code-host adapters.

interface.shortDescription: Frame, plan, execute, and merge with durable project memory.
interface.longDescription: Turn rough ideas into ADR-backed issues, sequence work by value, and run a gated issue-to-merge delivery loop over YouTrack, DevHubTracker, or a Linear append-only lifecycle projection and GitHub with Lupin, Eiffel, Maigret, and Vauban. Linear never replaces existing issue fields; its native board state, atomic Epic closure, and ADR knowledge base remain unavailable to Foundry, and live cutover is separate work.
defaultPrompt: Frame this idea into ADRs and precise issues.
Recommend the next issue by value and dependencies.
Review and merge this issue through every gate.
